items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-07-31
items.q: The interviewee discusses Paul Balburn's band and an event at the Yacht Club where photographs were taken, but does not claim a direct personal or professional relationship with Paul Balburn himself.

ctx.x: No, I don't think you were. That was, I got worried and went to it, but I don't remember. You know, there were things that you and I happened to hit on together at that period, and there were things that we didn't.

Yeah. There were all kind of different things going on. There was a tremendous lot of music going on that we never found out about for years either. Yeah, that's true. And the little neighborhood dance halls, and how could you find out about the things? Like, you went out and took photographs of Paul Balburn's band. Right, out at the Yacht Club? At the Yacht Club.

And that, you weren't, the average person didn't get in the Yacht Club very easily. I don't know how. It was the numbers only. I don't know how I got in the Yacht Club on that particular incident. Yeah. On that particular occasion. Do you remember? No, I wasn't there. I wasn't a member. Mm-hmm. And there were three or four of us, at least, that went. Mm-hmm. And I don't quite know how it happened. It was an afternoon occasion. But the details at the moment, I don't recall.
